inventedEvidence.evidence: Minor inference only: 'reseating the container made no difference' though the customer had not reported a test run after reseating

rationale: The assistant correctly ordered the work (unplug, container/filters, then look for the lower sump from the front), which led the customer to find the slimy sump and get a real improvement, matching the ground truth's sensible first step. It kept appropriate uncertainty between residual blockage, pump and float switch, recommended no parts, and escalated to an engineer with a useful handover given the stacked unit. Weaknesses are minor: it never asked for the full model number or whether the pump could be heard running, slipped in 'condenser/heat-pump' hedging, and asserted 'reseating the container made no difference' before the customer had reported a test.
